Definition: from G1722 and G2041; active, operative:--effectual, powerful.
BiblicalUsage: Energes is active, operative, powerful. A great door and effectual is opened to Paul in 1 Corinthians 16:9, the word of God is quick and powerful in Hebrews 4:12, and Paul prays that the sharing of Philemon's faith may become effectual in Philemon 1:6.
TheologicalSignificance: The word of God is not a dead letter but a living power, I believe — it pierces, it discerns, it opens doors no man can shut. I hold that when I read Scripture I am handling something alive, and I should expect it to cut.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; God's Power; Prayer
